title: Lane 3 — photographed-media inventory (metadata, NOT six-role completion)
sampling_method: Individually fetched all 22 current canonical species.json files; counted images[].file paths beginning images/, visual_comparison.items, and marker objects. important_note: Numbers are inventory metrics; not 181 distinct verified diagnostic photos and not 255 independently verified anatomical arrows.
